A higher low pattern (5-day low $51.71 > 20-day low $50.25 * 1.005) is observed, signaling potential recovery. However, trading volume at 0.50x the 5-day average is subdued, reducing confidence in a trend reversal. The current price ($59.74) faces resistance from SMA20 ($63.85) and EMA50 ($68.39). Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
